messages:
Carmen Diaz: opened a small PR to add ClickHouse / SQL examples for cost attribution + a .NET SDK tracing snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1002 - would love a quick review on accuracy and security wording. cc @Noah @Ellen
Noah Blake: taking a look. love the ClickHouse examples. one thought: show both aggregated (per-model) and per-route breakdowns. customers with ClickHouse will copy/paste.
Ellen Park: agreed. also we need a short privacy note: do not suggest storing full prompts in traces or metrics. link to the privacy recommendations page.
Carmen Diaz: added a privacy callout and a small jq snippet to help migrate dashboards (`panel.metrics` -> `panels[].metrics`). jq: `jq '.panels |= map(.metrics = (.metrics // .legacy_metrics))' old.json > new.json`
Noah Blake: nice. SQL examples look good. propose adding this ClickHouse query for per-model per-hour average token cost:
```sql
SELECT
  toStartOfHour(timestamp) AS hour,
  model,
  sum(token_cost_usd) / NULLIF(sum(tokens), 0) AS avg_token_cost_usd,
  sum(token_cost_usd) AS total_cost_usd
FROM redwood_traces
WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 24 hour
GROUP BY hour, model
ORDER BY hour DESC, model;
```
Ellen Park: also include a route-level variant `GROUP BY route, model` and a short note about sampling: if customers sample traces, cost metrics may be biased—recommend using exported metrics for billing-sensitive dashboards.
Carmen Diaz: added route example and a short paragraph about sampling vs full metrics. also included a .NET snippet showing how to attach cost/latency attributes to Activity (System.Diagnostics) so customers using Application Insights or OTLP can pick it up:
```csharp
using System.Diagnostics;

var activitySource = new ActivitySource("redwood.docs");
using var activity = activitySource.StartActivity("generate");
activity?.SetTag("redwood.cost.token_usd", 0.00105);
activity?.SetTag("redwood.latency.ms", 95);
// do NOT attach raw prompt text here; see privacy guidance
```
Noah Blake: perfect. minor copy nit: change heading from "Cost attribution" to "Cost attribution (per-route / per-model)" so it's clearer.
Ellen Park: security-bot ping: please include a short sentence about secret redaction in example payloads and recommend KMS-backed keys for CI sandboxes.
Carmen Diaz: added the security note and linked to the internal KMS docs. also added a tiny e2e CI check (docs/tests/check_clickhouse_examples.sh) that runs a lint against the SQL snippets to ensure they parse.
docs-bot: Preview build created: https://deploy-preview-1002--docs.redwood.ai/ :white_check_mark:
ci-bot: Sandbox endpoint available at https://sandbox-1002.redwood-inference.internal/example/trace (requires Authorization header). CI ran the snippet linter and returned OK.
Ellen Park: LGTM assuming privacy wording is strong enough. maybe add a one-liner: "Avoid logging unredacted inputs or user identifiers in trace attributes."
Carmen Diaz: added that sentence, pushed changes. planning to merge tomorrow after one more tech docs review. thanks all! :sparkles:
